model.acme.int_subscription_months.name: int_subscription_months
model.acme.int_subscription_months.raw_code:
-- One row per paid subscription per calendar month in which it is active at month end.
with months as (
    select cast(range as date) as month_start
    from range(date '2026-01-01', date '2026-07-01', interval 1 month)
),

subscriptions as (
    select
        s.subscription_id,
        c.account_id,
        s.plan_id,
        s.quantity,
        s.started_at,
        s.canceled_at,
        p.amount_usd,
        p.billing_interval,
        p.is_trial
    from {{ ref('stg_stripe__subscriptions') }} as s
    join {{ ref('stg_stripe__customers') }} as c using (stripe_customer_id)
    join {{ ref('stg_stripe__plans') }} as p using (plan_id)
)

select
    s.subscription_id,
    s.account_id,
    m.month_start,
    s.plan_id,
    case when s.billing_interval = 'year' then s.amount_usd * s.quantity / 12 else s.amount_usd * s.quantity end as monthly_amount_usd
from subscriptions as s
join months as m
    on s.started_at < m.month_start + interval 1 month
    and (s.canceled_at is null or s.canceled_at >= m.month_start + interval 1 month)
where not s.is_trial

model.acme.fct_mrr.name: fct_mrr
model.acme.fct_mrr.description: Monthly recurring revenue by account and month, with the month's change category.

mrr_usd.name: mrr_usd
mrr_usd.description: Normalized monthly amount of the account's paid subscriptions active at month end.

model.acme.fct_mrr.raw_code:
with monthly as (
    select account_id, month_start, sum(monthly_amount_usd) as mrr_usd
    from {{ ref('int_subscription_months') }}
    group by 1, 2
),

months as (
    select distinct month_start from {{ ref('int_subscription_months') }}
),

spine as (
    select a.account_id, m.month_start
    from (select account_id, min(month_start) as first_month from monthly group by 1) as a
    join months as m on m.month_start >= a.first_month
),

filled as (
    select s.account_id, s.month_start, coalesce(m.mrr_usd, 0) as mrr_usd
    from spine as s
    left join monthly as m using (account_id, month_start)
),

compared as (
    select
        *,
        coalesce(lag(mrr_usd) over (partition by account_id order by month_start), 0) as previous_mrr_usd,
        max(mrr_usd) over (partition by account_id order by month_start rows between unbounded preceding and 1 preceding) as best_previous_mrr_usd
    from filled
)

select
    account_id,
    month_start,
    mrr_usd,
    previous_mrr_usd,
    mrr_usd - previous_mrr_usd as mrr_change_usd,
    case
        when previous_mrr_usd = 0 and coalesce(best_previous_mrr_usd, 0) = 0 and mrr_usd > 0 then 'new'
        when previous_mrr_usd = 0 and mrr_usd > 0 then 'reactivation'
        when previous_mrr_usd > 0 and mrr_usd = 0 then 'churn'
        when mrr_usd > previous_mrr_usd then 'expansion'
        when mrr_usd < previous_mrr_usd then 'contraction'
        else 'unchanged'
    end as change_category
from compared
where mrr_usd > 0 or previous_mrr_usd > 0

macro.dbt_duckdb.duckdb__get_catalog_tab.macro_sql:
{% macro duckdb__get_catalog_tables_sql(information_schema) -%}
    select *
    from (
        select
            t.database_name as table_database,
            t.schema_name as table_schema,
            t.table_name as table_name,
            'BASE TABLE' as table_type,
            t.comment as table_comment
        from duckdb_tables() t
        where upper(t.database_name) = upper('{{ information_schema.database }}')

        union all

        select
            v.database_name as table_database,
            v.schema_name as table_schema,
            v.view_name as table_name,
            'VIEW' as table_type,
            v.comment as table_comment
        from duckdb_views() v
        where upper(v.database_name) = upper('{{ information_schema.database }}')
    ) catalog_tables
{%- endmacro %}

### Welcome!

Welcome to the auto-generated documentation for your dbt project!

### Navigation

You can use the `Project` and `Database` navigation tabs on the left side of the window to explore the models
in your project.

#### Project Tab
The `Project` tab mirrors the directory structure of your dbt project. In this tab, you can see all of the
models defined in your dbt project, as well as models imported from dbt packages.

#### Database Tab
The `Database` tab also exposes your models, but in a format that looks more like a database explorer. This view
shows relations (tables and views) grouped into database schemas. Note that ephemeral models are _not_ shown
in this interface, as they do not exist in the database.

### Graph Exploration
You can click the blue icon on the bottom-right corner of the page to view the lineage graph of your models.

On model pages, you'll see the immediate parents and children of the model you're exploring. By clicking the `Expand`
button at the top-right of this lineage pane, you'll be able to see all of the models that are used to build,
or are built from, the model you're exploring.

Once expanded, you'll be able to use the `--select` and `--exclude` model selection syntax to filter the
models in the graph. For more information on model selection, check out the [dbt docs](https://docs.getdbt.com/docs/model-selection-syntax).

Note that you can also right-click on models to interactively filter and explore the graph.
